questions.text: Which organ in your head controls thought and memory?
questions.explanation: The brain is the control centre of the nervous system.
The skull encloses and protects the brain.

questions.text: Which part of the body is covered in taste buds?
questions.explanation: Taste buds are found mainly on the tongue.

questions.text: How many bones does a typical adult human have?
Which gas do we breathe out as a waste product?
questions.explanation: Exhaled air carries carbon dioxide produced by cells.

questions.text: Which vitamin is also known as ascorbic acid?
questions.explanation: Ascorbic acid is the chemical name for vitamin C.

questions.text: What is the long bone of the upper arm called?
questions.explanation: The humerus runs from shoulder to elbow.
Beta cells in the pancreas make insulin.

questions.text: Which cell structure is known as the powerhouse of the cell?
questions.explanation: Mitochondria generate most of a cell's ATP.

questions.text: Which part of the eye gives it its colour?
questions.explanation: The iris contains the pigment that determines eye colour.

questions.text: What is the smallest bone in the human body?
questions.explanation: The stapes in the middle ear is the smallest human bone.

questions.text: Which part of the brain chiefly coordinates balance and movement?
questions.explanation: The cerebellum fine-tunes coordination and balance.

questions.text: Which dome-shaped muscle beneath the lungs does most of the work of breathing?
questions.explanation: The diaphragm contracts to draw air into the lungs.

questions.text: Which heart valve lies between the left atrium and left ventricle?
questions.explanation: The mitral (bicuspid) valve guards the left atrioventricular opening.

questions.text: Which cranial nerve, the longest, runs from the brain down into the abdomen?
questions.explanation: The vagus nerve wanders from the brainstem to the abdomen.

spares.text: Which pair of organs do we use to breathe?
spares.explanation: The lungs exchange oxygen and carbon dioxide.

spares.text: Which gland at the base of the brain is called the master gland?
spares.explanation: The pituitary controls many other endocrine glands.

spares.text: In DNA, which base pairs with adenine?
spares.explanation: Adenine pairs with thymine in DNA.
